column2: English prompt written by a user (\n = newline). An Amharic request is added by step 2.
My landlord sent me this: "Rent will be adjusted effective next quarter in line with market rates." What does he actually mean?
I got this email from a company: "We regret to inform you that we will not be moving forward with your application at this time." Did I get the job or not?
What does "terms and conditions apply" mean when a shop writes it under a discount?
My manager wrote "Let's circle back on this next week." Is that a yes or a no?
The medicine box says "Take one tablet twice daily after meals. Do not exceed the stated dose." What exactly should I do?
A scholarship site says the applicant must be "a citizen in good standing with no outstanding obligations". What does that mean?
What is the difference between "net salary" and "gross salary"?
My bank SMS says "Your account has been debited ETB 1,250.00". Did money go in or out?
What does "ASAP" mean in a work message, and is it rude to use it?
The NGO job post asks for "strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work under minimal supervision". What are they looking for?
My phone shows "Storage almost full. Manage storage to free up space." What should I do first?
Explain what an "internship" is and how it is different from a normal job.
The teacher wrote on my son's report: "Shows potential but needs to apply himself more consistently." What is she trying to tell me?
What does "out of office" mean in an automatic email reply?
Someone on Facebook says I won a prize and must "verify my account by sending the OTP code". Is this safe?
The visa page says "Applicants must show proof of sufficient funds." What documents usually count as proof?
What is the meaning of "deadline extended until further notice"?
I keep seeing "AI" and "machine learning" in job ads. What is the difference between them?
My laptop says "Windows is updating, do not turn off your computer." How long can this take and what happens if the power goes off?
A client wrote "Kindly revert at your earliest convenience." What does "revert" mean here?
My daughter's school sent this note: "Parent-teacher conferences will be held next Thursday. Please sign up for a time slot." What do I need to do?
What does "non-refundable deposit" mean on a hotel booking?
The job ad says "competitive salary commensurate with experience". How much will they pay?
I received "Your parcel is held at customs pending payment of duties." What should I do next?
What is the difference between "affect" and "effect"? I always mix them up.
My doctor wrote "BID" and "PRN" on my prescription. What do these abbreviations mean?
A website asks me to "accept all cookies". What happens if I accept or reject?
What does "probation period" mean in my employment contract?
How do I politely say no to extra work in an English email to my manager?
What does "per annum" mean in a loan offer?
Explain the difference between a debit card and a credit card.
The landlord's contract says "tenant is responsible for minor repairs". What counts as minor?
My English teacher said my essay is "too wordy". How do I fix that?
What is a "reference letter" and who should I ask to write one?
A friend texted "LOL, TBH I can't make it, BRB". What do these abbreviations mean?
The airline says my flight is "overbooked" and offers a voucher. What are my options?
What does "subject to availability" mean in an advertisement?
How should I answer "Where do you see yourself in five years?" in an interview?
My bank statement shows "service charge" every month. What is it for?
What does "carbon footprint" mean, in simple words?
I was told my CV should have "action verbs". Give me examples and explain why.
What does "terms of reference" mean in an NGO tender document?
Is "I am agree" correct English? How should I say it?
Explain what inflation is using an example from buying bread every week.
What does "the meeting has been moved up" mean? Earlier or later?
What should I check before signing an online "terms of service" agreement?
My boss wrote "Please action this by EOD." What does that mean?
